claims.text: Nimbus 2.0 was published on 2026-03-14 and ships with no runtime dependencies.

evidence.snippet: Nimbus 2.0 is available today, and its runtime dependency list is empty by design.

claims.text: The project passed 12,000 stars within three months of the 2.0 release.

evidence.snippet: As of June 2026 the repository shows about 12,400 stars, up from 4,100 in March.

claims.text: Growth is explained mainly by build-time wins rather than by marketing activity.

evidence.snippet: Analysts point to install size and build speed, not campaigns, as the driver.
The comparison shows the build step finishing well ahead of the alternatives.
The entry summarises the project as a zero-dependency build tool.

claims.text: If the current rate holds, the project is projected to pass 20,000 stars by the end of 2026.

evidence.snippet: Growth of roughly 2,700 stars per month was recorded between March and June.

claims.text: A widely repeated claim that the 2.0 release removed plugin support is contradicted by the release notes.

evidence.snippet: Plugin support is retained in 2.0; the loader was rewritten but the interface is unchanged.
Community reports of removed plugin support do not match the released notes.

claims.text: The 2.0 release-notes page answered successfully when checked on 2026-09-29.

sources.title: Build-time comparison: Nimbus and three alternatives

observations.method: checked the release-notes page from the documentation host

writing_context.text: Star counts are a snapshot; no daily history is publicly archived.
writing_context.use: Date-stamp every star figure instead of presenting a growth curve.

writing_context.text: The build-time comparison uses a single machine and a warm cache.
writing_context.use: Qualify the comparison as indicative rather than general.

key_findings.finding: Nimbus grew quickly after 2.0, and the available evidence attributes that growth to build-time improvements rather than promotion.
A widely repeated claim about removed plugin support is contradicted by the release notes.
